dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: A type of arithmetic models. Its constructor and projections show that an element packages a real scalar u, a proof 0 < u, a binary operation fl_add on the reals, and a proof of the per-operation error model stated in D006.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The universally quantified fp supplies both the error parameter u and the modeled addition operation used throughout the target. Quantification is restricted to packages satisfying the constructor's error property.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The third projection of an arithmetic model: LocalDef002 fp is its binary real operation fl_add.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This operation computes the recursive floating-point-style sum in D005 and the partial sums appearing in D004.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: The first projection of an arithmetic model: LocalDef003 fp is its positive real parameter u.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the scalar multiplying the error accumulator on the right-hand side of the final inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: For fp, n, and v, this defines a real accumulator B_n(v). It satisfies B_0 = B_1 = 0 and, for k >= 1, B_(k+1)(v) = B_k(v restricted to its first k entries) + |S_k(v restricted to its first k entries)| + |v_k|, where S is D005 using fp.fl_add. Equivalently, B_n(v) is the exact real sum over k = 1,...,n-1 of |S_k(v_0,...,v_(k-1))| + |v_k|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the data- and operation-dependent quantity multiplied by u on the right-hand side. Its own additions and absolute values are exact real operations.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: Given flAdd, it defines the left-to-right recursive sum S_n(v): S_0 = 0, S_1(v) = v_0, and for k >= 1, S_(k+1)(v) = flAdd(S_k(v restricted to its first k entries), v_k). Thus flAdd is not called for vectors of length zero or one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: S_n(v) is the computed sum compared with the exact finite sum on the left-hand side, and its earlier values also occur inside the accumulator D004.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for LocalDef001. It requires u in the reals with 0 < u and an operation fl_add such that, for every real x and y, there exist real alpha and beta satisfying |alpha| <= u, |beta| <= u, and fl_add(x,y) = x(1+alpha) + y(1+beta).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This packages the hypotheses used implicitly by every quantified fp. The two perturbation witnesses may depend on x and y.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: A dependent case splitter for a natural-number dimension and a vector of that dimension. It selects either the dimension-zero branch or the dimension-(n+1) branch.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It separates the base and successor cases in the recursive definition of the accumulator D004; it adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: A theorem that n = 0 implies 0 < n + 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the proof that index 0 belongs to Fin (n+1) in the singleton branch of D005. It contributes no additional assumption to the final proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: The same dependent natural-number/vector case splitter as D007.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects the empty-vector or successor-vector branch in the recursive definition of the computed sum D005.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite index type whose values are natural numbers strictly less than n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes v an n-component real vector indexed by 0 through n-1 and determines the domain of the exact finite sum.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite-type structure enumerating all elements of Fin n, implemented using the list of indices below n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It lets Finset.univ enumerate every vector index for the exact sum.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite sum of a function over a finite set, using the additive commutative monoid operation; the empty sum is zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the exact real sum of all entries v_i.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite set containing every element of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For Fin n, it makes the exact sum range over precisely i = 0,...,n-1.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous multiplication operation selected from an HMul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the real multiplication instance, it denotes the ordinary real product u * B_n(v).

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous subtraction operation selected from an HSub instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the real subtraction instance, it forms S_n(v) minus the exact sum.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: The less-than-or-equal relation supplied by an LE instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the real-order instance, it is the ordinary real inequality in the conclusion and in the bounds on alpha and beta.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural numbers, including zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The natural number n is the vector dimension, and natural-number recursion defines D004 and D005.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Vector entries, computed sums, exact sums, perturbations, u, and the error bound are all real-valued.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive commutative monoid structure on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real addition and zero to Finset.sum, so the exact vector sum is the ordinary finite real sum.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive group structure on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real negation required by the definition of absolute value.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual less-than-or-equal relation on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets every occurrence of <= as ordinary real order.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual multiplication operation on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets u times the accumulator and the products in the local error model as ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real subtraction, defined as addition of the negation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the error expression the computed sum minus the exact sum.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.lattice
dependency_coverage.meaning: The lattice structure on the reals, including the maximum operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the additive group structure, it supports the definition |a| = max(a,-a).

dependency_coverage.name: abs
dependency_coverage.meaning: Absolute value in a lattice-ordered additive group, defined as max(a,-a); on the reals this is the usual absolute value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It measures the final forward error, bounds alpha and beta, and measures partial sums and entries in D004.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The adapter turning an ordinary multiplication instance into homogeneous HMul.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes HMul.hMul to ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The adapter turning an ordinary subtraction instance into homogeneous HSub.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes HSub.hSub to ordinary real subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the exact local error-model equation and controls the tests for whether a recursive predecessor dimension equals zero.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.castSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: The inclusion Fin n -> Fin (n+1) preserving the numerical index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts a vector of length n+1 to its first n entries when making recursive calls.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.last
dependency_coverage.meaning: For n, the final index n in Fin (n+1).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects the last component v_n in the successor cases of D004 and D005.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.mk
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor making an element of Fin n from a natural value and a proof that the value is less than n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It constructs index 0 in the singleton-vector branch of D005.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous addition operation selected from an HAdd instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It denotes ordinary addition for real accumulator terms and natural addition in dimensions such as n+1.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.below
dependency_coverage.meaning: The course-of-values recursion package containing results for smaller natural numbers; at a successor it pairs the immediate predecessor result with the package for earlier values.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the immediately preceding vector-length result available to the recursive definitions D004 and D005.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.brecOn
dependency_coverage.meaning: Course-of-values recursion on a natural number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the recursive definitions of the computed sum and its error accumulator.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.succ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The successor operation on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It represents dimensions of the form n+1 in the recursive successor cases.

dependency_coverage.name: Not
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical negation, defined by Not P = P -> False.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the type of evidence supplied to the false branch of the dimension-equality conditionals.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interpretation of natural-number literals in a type with an OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the literals 0 and 1 used in dimensions, base values, positivity, and the perturbation equation.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual addition operation on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It performs the exact real additions in D004 and in x(1+alpha) + y(1+beta).

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The zero element of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the zero base cases for D004 and D005 and the lower endpoint in 0 < u.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: The adapter interpreting the numeral 0 using a type's Zero instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes real literal 0 denote the ordinary real zero.

dependency_coverage.name: dite
dependency_coverage.meaning: A dependent conditional whose selected branch receives a proof or refutation of its condition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: In D005, the n=0 proof allows construction of index 0 in Fin (n+1); otherwise the recursive fl_add branch is selected.

dependency_coverage.name: instAddNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual addition operation on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets n+1 in finite-index dimensions.

dependency_coverage.name: instDecidableEqNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The decision procedure for equality of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the tests n=0 in D004 and D005 computationally decidable.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The adapter turning an ordinary addition instance into homogeneous HAdd.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes HAdd.hAdd to ordinary real or natural addition as appropriate.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical interpretation of each natural numeral as itself.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the natural literals 0 and 1 used by dimension arithmetic and case tests.

dependency_coverage.name: ite
dependency_coverage.meaning: An ordinary conditional choosing between two values according to a decidable proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.zero

dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual strict order on natural numbers.

binders: fp ranges over arithmetic-model packages consisting of a real u, a proof that 0 < u, a binary operation fl_add : Real x Real -> Real, and the error-model proof described below.
n ranges over all natural numbers, including 0.
v : Fin n -> Real is an arbitrary n-component real vector, indexed by i = 0,...,n-1.
hypotheses: The scalar u stored in fp satisfies 0 < u.
For every pair of real numbers x and y, there exist real numbers alpha and beta such that |alpha| <= u, |beta| <= u, and fl_add(x,y) = x(1+alpha) + y(1+beta).
conclusions: Let S_n(v) be the left-to-right fl_add sum and B_n(v) the recursively defined accumulator. Then |S_n(v) - sum_{i=0}^{n-1} v_i| <= u B_n(v).
mathematical_definitions: Write u = fp.u and x (+_fp) y = fp.fl_add(x,y).
For k <= n, write v|k for the vector of the first k entries of v.
The computed sum is S_0 = 0, S_1(v) = v_0, and S_(k+1)(v) = S_k(v|k) (+_fp) v_k for every k >= 1. Thus S_n is the left-associated expression ((v_0 (+_fp) v_1) (+_fp) ...) (+_fp) v_(n-1) when n >= 2.
The exact sum is T_n(v) = sum over all i in Fin n of v_i, namely the ordinary real sum v_0 + ... + v_(n-1), with T_0 = 0.
The accumulator is B_0 = 0, B_1 = 0, and B_(k+1)(v) = B_k(v|k) + |S_k(v|k)| + |v_k| for k >= 1. Hence B_n(v) = sum from k=1 to n-1 of (|S_k(v|k)| + |v_k|), with an empty sum for n <= 1.
All subtraction, multiplication, addition inside B_n, finite summation, ordering, and absolute values outside fl_add are exact operations on real numbers.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every packaged arithmetic model with positive parameter u whose addition of any two real operands can be represented by independently perturbing each operand by relative amounts of magnitude at most u, every dimension n, and every real vector v of that dimension, the absolute difference between the left-to-right sum computed with the model's addition and the exact real sum is at most u times the exact accumulator obtained by adding, at each noninitial step, the absolute value of the preceding computed partial sum and the absolute value of the new entry.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: There is no assumption n >= 2. For n = 0, both sums and the bound are zero. For n = 1, the computed sum is exactly v_0 and B_1 = 0. These two cases are therefore trivial.
The vector entries are arbitrary real numbers; there are no sign, nonzero, magnitude, or normalization assumptions.
Only 0 < u is required. No upper bound such as u < 1 is encoded.
The local model uses two independently bounded perturbations, one on each operand: x(1+alpha) + y(1+beta). It is not a single relative-error formula of the form (x+y)(1+delta).
The existential perturbations alpha and beta may depend on the particular operands x and y and need not be unique or consistent between calls.
The binary function fl_add is otherwise unconstrained; associativity, commutativity, exactness on special inputs, and any concrete rounding rule are not assumed.
The computed sum has a fixed left-to-right evaluation order. The proposition does not cover arbitrary parenthesizations or reordering.
The accumulator B_n is not an input-only norm. It depends on the computed partial sums and therefore on fp.fl_add as well as on v.
The arithmetic used to compute B_n and the exact comparison sum is exact real arithmetic; only calls used to form S_n employ fl_add.
No floating-point format, representability condition, rounding mode, overflow, underflow, subnormal behavior, infinities, or NaNs are encoded.
The conclusion is an absolute forward-error bound only. It does not claim a relative bound, backward stability, sharpness, attainability, or equality.

Quantification over fp does not range over arbitrary binary real operations; an operation can instantiate fp only together with the positivity and existential perturbation proofs required by LocalDef001.
